newsitem.title: USA: Ziegler to sell leasing unit, take gain.
newsitem.headline: Ziegler to sell leasing unit, take gain.

text.p: Ziegler Cos Inc, a financial services holding company, said it signed a nonbinding letter of intent to sell its Ziegler Leasing Corp subsidiary to a major financial services company.

It said the proposed cash offer is valued at about $17 million, and Ziegler Cos expects to realize about $11 million, after tax, which approximates the book value of Ziegler Leasing Corp as of September 30.
In 1996, Ziegler Leasing posted revenues of about $10.5 million and net income of $716,000.
The proposed sale is subject to the buyer's due diligence, approval of its board and Hart-Scott-Rodino approval. It is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 1996.
Proceeds of the sale are anticipated to be reinvested in securities-related activities.
